clauses.zh: 以靛蓝为主色，唯一醒目的橙红落在{{focus}}。
clauses.en: Use indigo as the main color, with orange-red as the sole prominent accent at {{focus}}.

clauses.zh: 将细节集中在{{detail}}，外围保持疏朗。
clauses.en: Concentrate detail at {{detail}} and keep the surrounding area sparse.

clauses.zh: 用粗细分明的靛蓝线条与平面墨块塑形，米白纸面保留轻微纤维。
clauses.en: Build forms with indigo lines of distinct weights and flat ink shapes over lightly fibrous off-white paper.

clauses.zh: 场景为{{environment}}，后景只交代必要内容。
clauses.en: Set the image in {{environment}}, using only essential background detail.
